about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps, game 1.60.1.70938, site built 2026-11-16 from commit e4ef929), since its mage sim ships no weights. Its Fire preset (talents, rotation, buffs) on its own Preraid gear set (ui/specs/mage/dps/gear_sets/preraid.gear.json, which replaced P1 Arcane for every mage build; imported as SIML by item ID), 12,500 iterations, reference stat Spell Damage. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. Run in the app's browser on 15 Nov 2026 (US Central); John: "Yes, re-run them". Before it, on P1 Arcane (14 Nov): Intellect 0.29, Spell Damage 1.0, Arcane Spell Damage 0.12, Fire Spell Damage 0.88, Frost Spell Damage 0.0, Spell Piercing 2.17, Spirit 0.0, 1% Hit 16.76, 1% Crit 10.87, 1% Haste 10.98, Mana 0.0, MP5 0.0.
